prompt: 把这份 EndNote XML 导出迁入隔离 Zotero profile 管理，先做身份映射和人工批准，不要动日常主库，也不要启动 Word。
expected_reason: EndNote literature import into isolated Zotero for management.

prompt: 把这篇 Word 里的 EndNote 动态引用迁到隔离 Zotero profile，先做 cited-only 身份映射和人工批准，不要覆盖原稿，也不要启动 Word。
expected_reason: EndNote-to-Zotero dynamic field migration with isolation and a human approval gate.

prompt: Help me switch Windows Zotero to an isolated citation-migration profile and confirm Word will not attach to my daily library before any Refresh.
expected_reason: Isolated Zotero profiles as a prerequisite of EndNote-to-Zotero migration.

prompt: 映射表里还有两处题名年份歧义。先停在人工批准门，不要写 Zotero 字段。
expected_reason: Human approval gate before writing Zotero fields during EndNote migration.

prompt: EndNote 迁移在 Refresh 后停下。根据工作目录里的哈希和批准表恢复到最高已核验阶段，必要时给一份只复制的 rollback 提案。
expected_reason: Recovery and rollback for an EndNote-to-Zotero citation run.

prompt: 把这篇 Word 里的 DOI 和 PMID 标记转成可刷新的 Zotero 引用字段。
expected_reason: DOI/PMID live fields and Zotero MCP library work belong to zotero-livecite.

prompt: What is the difference between APA 7 and Vancouver citation style?
expected_reason: General citation-style advice with no EndNote or Zotero Word fields.

prompt: Format these ten references as plain text in Chicago style for an email.
expected_reason: Plain bibliography formatting, not EndNote-to-Zotero field migration.

prompt: Help me install the Zotero Word add-in.
expected_reason: Installation rather than protected EndNote-to-Zotero conversion.
